segments.title: Cold Open & No Breaks November Launch
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on; Case announces daily Mon-Sat streams all November, special Nov 20 Kickstarter launch for 13 Freak Street horror anthology.

segments.title: 13 Freak Street Kickstarter Promotion
segments.notes: Case details 13-short horror comedy anthology with John Madison hosting, Fiona directing, Jace Armstrong producing; no AI used; poster by Libby; Kevin character death referenced; 100 follow milestone reached live.

segments.title: Haley Stevens Meltdown & Election Analysis
segments.notes: Case and Liliana dissect Michigan Rep. Haley Stevens' de-endorsement of Abdul El-Sayed, endorsement of Mike Rogers, Anderson Cooper interview, and Israel-aligned PAC pressure; broader election pessimism expressed.

segments.title: Tucker Carlson Nuclear Strike Claims
segments.notes: Case addresses Tucker Carlson report of imminent Trump nuclear strike on Iran; discusses doctrinal deterrence, Trump unpredictability, and Democratic party foreign policy failures.

segments.title: Chat Poll: What To Do
segments.notes: Case runs chat poll with options: No Breaks, Nuke Rico, Sleep, Nuke Election, Shit Furiously; 'Shit Furiously' wins; Case riffs on human constancy.

segments.title: Chat News: Viewer-Submitted Stories
segments.notes: Case and Liliana cover: PA man's 1,207 movie screenings/year; dog Rocco eats crock-pot-juice rocks, survives surgery; SF startup pays $20/hr to walk robot dogs; 'too fat to fly' hawk eating chickens; penis enlargement industry documentary; Dave Batista 20-lb God of War bulk; Hassan Piker near-nude RNC photo; Carroll County data center noise protest.

segments.title: Debate: Who's the Freakiest?
segments.notes: Munch (now immortal talking skeleton) and Crum debate meaning of 'freak'; Munch claims positive freak supremacy with rave-pants aesthetic; Crum insists Munch is bad-freak skeleton; Pepito awards point to Munch.

segments.title: Basement Karate & Scare Pranks
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget tries on glasses, presents karate tutorial (nunchucks, one-inch punch) and Zappos office scare compilation; Jeb's Dad (trapped in wood) interjects, forbids jazz, reveals Crum-Hype Train hell liaison.

segments.title: Metal Slug 2 on Keyboard
segments.notes: Brandon (CryptoZeu$) raids in, plays browser Metal Slug 2 with keyboard controls, accidentally kills Pete Hegseth sprite, loses war, promotes Queen Goldie sponsorship; Case notes Brandon 'looks weird lately'.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid to Tasty
segments.notes: Case plugs Kickstarter (103 follows), confirms election coverage tomorrow ~5:30 PM PT, Sundays off for mental health, raids Tasty as part of No Breaks November.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on, manages Kickstarter follow alert graphics, awards debate point to Munch.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors No Breaks November launch, promotes 13 Freak Street Kickstarter, runs news desk and chat poll, hosts election coverage preview.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchors news block, dissects Haley Stevens clips, reacts to chat news stories, debates Big Bird attraction.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears as immortal talking skeleton post-Crum Dick Punch, claims positive freak supremacy, wins debate point from Pepito.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Munch on freak definition, insists Munch is bad-freak skeleton, referenced as having hell liaison with Hype Train.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosts How To with Jeb, attempts basement karate and scare pranks, bickers with Jeb's Dad over literacy and jazz.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (trapped in wood). Spirit in wooden board, forbids jazz, reveals Crum-Hype Train hell encounter, asks if today is Crumb Punch Day.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical correspondent. Referenced by Jeb's Dad as having hell encounter with Crum; does not appear live.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell kicks off No Breaks November with daily streams through the month, driving the 13 Freak Street Kickstarter to 103 follows. The news block covers Haley Stevens' chaotic de-endorsement of Abdul El-Sayed, Tucker Carlson's nuclear strike claims, and a chat news roundup featuring a rock-eating dog, robot dog walkers, and the penis enlargement industry. Munch, now a permanent talking skeleton, debates Crum on 'who's the freakiest' and wins Pepito's point. Jeb Nogget presents basement karate and scare pranks while his wood-trapped father reveals Crum's hell liaison with Hype Train. Brandon (CryptoZeu$) raids in for a keyboard-only Metal Slug 2 run, accidentally killing a Pete Hegseth sprite. The broadcast closes with a raid on Tasty and confirmation of election coverage tomorrow.
